en.title: Automatic Payment Processing
en.excerpt: How Archeris integrates real-time payment webhooks for instant QRIS and Virtual Account transaction verification.
en.content:
Payment Gateway Integration

Archeris connects with certified Indonesian payment processors (Mayar) to provide frictionless online checkouts. When an archer selects a tournament category, a unique digital invoice is generated with localized payment options.

Real-Time Webhook Processing

When an athlete completes a payment via QRIS or Bank Virtual Account, the payment gateway dispatches an encrypted webhook notification to Archeris servers. The system verifies the transaction payload and immediately marks the registration as Verified (Paid) within seconds.

Organizer Revenue Disbursements

Collected tournament entry fees accumulate in the Organizer's digital balance. Organizers can request bank payouts to any verified Indonesian bank account (BCA, Mandiri, BNI, BRI) directly from the Earnings & Balance tab.

Handling Transaction Disputes

If an athlete cancels registration before the refund deadline, organizers can process cancellation records directly from the participant detail modal.
